stops.note: to send as ambassador, to depute, combined with de- (away)
stops.meaning: to send as ambassador, to depute

stops.note: to send as a deputy, to entrust, from de- and legare
stops.meaning: to send as a deputy, to entrust

stops.note: settled as the English word for entrusting a task to someone, or a person sent to represent others
stops.meaning: to entrust a task to someone, or a person sent to represent others

current_meaning: to entrust a task or responsibility to another person, or a representative sent to act for others
